options.label: Make paneer from milk
method_steps: Bring 1 liter milk to a gentle boil for 2–3 minutes
Add 1–2 tbsp lemon juice or vinegar while stirring until curds form
Strain through cheesecloth, rinse, and press 15–20 minutes

options.label: Make paneer from curd/yogurt
method_steps: Warm 1 cup milk with 1 cup thick yogurt until curds separate
Strain and press as for milk paneer
Cube and use in curry

options.label: Make buttermilk from milk + acid
method_steps: Measure 1 cup milk
Stir in 1 tbsp lemon juice or vinegar
Rest 5 minutes until slightly thickened

options.label: Make buttermilk from yogurt
method_steps: Whisk equal parts yogurt and water until pourable
Use immediately as buttermilk

options.label: Make butter from cream
method_steps: Whip cold heavy cream past soft peaks until butterfat separates
Drain buttermilk; rinse butter under cold water
Knead lightly and salt if desired

options.label: Make yogurt/curd from milk
method_steps: Scald milk and cool to lukewarm
Stir in 1–2 tbsp plain yogurt as starter
Incubate warm 6–8 hours until set

options.label: Make ricotta-style cheese from milk
method_steps: Heat milk until steaming
Add lemon juice; stir until curds form
Strain lightly for a softer cheese

options.label: Make sourdough starter from flour + water
method_steps: Mix equal weights flour and water
Rest warm 24 hours; feed daily equal flour and water
Ready when bubbly and doubling in 4–8 hours

options.label: Make ghee from butter
method_steps: Melt butter on low heat
Simmer until milk solids brown and separate
Strain clear fat and cool

options.label: Make scramble base from tofu
method_steps: Crumble firm tofu
Season with turmeric, salt, and pepper
Saute until hot and slightly dry

options.label: Make cream from cashews
method_steps: Soak cashews 20–30 minutes in hot water
Blend with fresh water until silky
Use as cream in sauces

options.label: Make almond milk
method_steps: Soak almonds overnight; drain
Blend with water; strain through nut milk bag
Chill and shake before use

options.label: Make vegetable broth from scraps
method_steps: Simmer vegetable scraps in water 45–60 minutes
Season lightly with salt and pepper
Strain and cool

options.label: Make Jain-friendly vegetable broth
method_steps: Simmer non-root allowed vegetables 45 minutes
Avoid onion and garlic
Strain and season

options.label: Reduce tomatoes into paste
method_steps: Cook chopped tomatoes down until thick
Blend smooth and continue reducing
Cool and use concentrated spoonfuls

options.label: Make breadcrumbs from bread
method_steps: Toast stale bread until dry
Pulse in a processor to coarse crumbs
Store airtight

options.label: Whip cream
method_steps: Chill cream and bowl
Whip to soft or stiff peaks
Sweeten if desired

options.label: Make a quick pickle brine
method_steps: Heat vinegar with sugar and salt until dissolved
Pour over sliced vegetables
Cool; ready in 30–60 minutes

options.label: Make a chia egg
method_steps: Mix 1 tbsp chia seeds with 3 tbsp water
Rest 5 minutes until gelled
Use as one egg binder

options.label: Make a flax egg
method_steps: Mix 1 tbsp ground flax with 3 tbsp water
Rest 5 minutes
Use as one egg binder

options.label: Make hummus from chickpeas
method_steps: Blend drained chickpeas with lemon, garlic, and oil
Add water to loosen
Season with salt
